anomalies.impact: The STM32 touch-sensing electrode is held at VCC instead of being connected to the TSC GPIO through R8. PB5 is effectively pulled high through R8, so the capacitive-touch button will not function. The exposed electrode also becomes a low-impedance VCC pad, which could short to ground if touched or bridged.
